text:
zoe: Quick question 1089 Tuesday morning? Thinking bagel breakfast to celebrate Priya's 3-year Redwood anniversary 389 and Marco's engagement 48d. 9:30am in the kitchen. Who can make it?
priya: Wait what 62d this is sooo sweet 970 I can make it, thanks zoe!
marco: No way 62c Im blushing. Love y'all 64f Were both in.
connor: I'll bring a french press and travel mugs 375
jen: Congrats Priya & Marco!! Can we do a small toast? Also gluten-free bagels pls 36f
zoe: Toast at 9:40, short and sweet. GF + vegan spread noted.
facilities-bot: Kitchen table reserved 9:20-10:00. Please return chairs to storage after use.
people-ops-bot: Card & small gift: we'll print a card that says "Congrats Priya (3 years!)" and "Congrats Marco & Sam". Team, please sign by Monday EOD. Gift budget: $60.
remote-bot: Remote folks: e-card is up for signatures: https://ecard.example.com/xyz. Happy to add messages from remote team.
catering-coordinator: We can supply 18 assorted bagels (plain, everything, sesame), 6 GF bagels, and spreads (cream cheese, vegan spread, hummus). Cost $42. Delivery Tue 9:10am.
connor: I'll pick up pastries if anyone wants croissants too.
jen: RSVP: me, zoe, priya, marco, connor, cam (remote), and sam (remote).
zoe: Perfect. People-ops will collect gift contributions; I'll post reminder Monday. Tiny banner idea? I'll tape a small "3 years" + "engaged" banner above the table.
marco: Please keep baby/engagement social posts internal for now; we'll share photos when ready.
priya: Thanks everyone. So happy to be here 970 see you Tuesday!
people-ops-bot: Reminder set: card printed Mon, e-card shared, catering ordered.
zoe: All set 44d see you Tuesday 9:30am (bagels and coffee).
